019package org.apache.bcel;
020
021/**
022 * Exception constants.
023 *
024 * @deprecated (since 6.0) DO NOT USE - use ExceptionConst instead
025 */
026@Deprecated
027public interface ExceptionConstants {
028
029    /**
030     * The mother of all exceptions
031     */
032    Class<Throwable> THROWABLE = Throwable.class;
033    /**
034     * Super class of any run-time exception
035     */
036    Class<RuntimeException> RUNTIME_EXCEPTION = RuntimeException.class;
037    /**
038     * Super class of any linking exception (aka Linkage Error)
039     */
040    Class<LinkageError> LINKING_EXCEPTION = LinkageError.class;
041    /**
042     * Linking Exceptions
043     */
044    Class<ClassCircularityError> CLASS_CIRCULARITY_ERROR = ClassCircularityError.class;
045    Class<ClassFormatError> CLASS_FORMAT_ERROR = ClassFormatError.class;
046    Class<ExceptionInInitializerError> EXCEPTION_IN_INITIALIZER_ERROR = ExceptionInInitializerError.class;
047    Class<IncompatibleClassChangeError> INCOMPATIBLE_CLASS_CHANGE_ERROR = IncompatibleClassChangeError.class;
048    Class<AbstractMethodError> ABSTRACT_METHOD_ERROR = AbstractMethodError.class;
049    Class<IllegalAccessError> ILLEGAL_ACCESS_ERROR = IllegalAccessError.class;
050    Class<InstantiationError> INSTANTIATION_ERROR = InstantiationError.class;
051    Class<NoSuchFieldError> NO_SUCH_FIELD_ERROR = NoSuchFieldError.class;
052    Class<NoSuchMethodError> NO_SUCH_METHOD_ERROR = NoSuchMethodError.class;
053    Class<NoClassDefFoundError> NO_CLASS_DEF_FOUND_ERROR = NoClassDefFoundError.class;
054    Class<UnsatisfiedLinkError> UNSATISFIED_LINK_ERROR = UnsatisfiedLinkError.class;
055    Class<VerifyError> VERIFY_ERROR = VerifyError.class;
056    /* UnsupportedClassVersionError is new in JDK 1.2 */
057//    Class UnsupportedClassVersionError = UnsupportedClassVersionError.class;
058    /**
059     * Run-Time Exceptions
060     */
061    Class<NullPointerException> NULL_POINTER_EXCEPTION = NullPointerException.class;
062    Class<ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException> ARRAY_INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS_EXCEPTION = ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.class;
063    Class<ArithmeticException> ARITHMETIC_EXCEPTION = ArithmeticException.class;
064    Class<NegativeArraySizeException> NEGATIVE_ARRAY_SIZE_EXCEPTION = NegativeArraySizeException.class;
065    Class<ClassCastException> CLASS_CAST_EXCEPTION = ClassCastException.class;
066    Class<IllegalMonitorStateException> ILLEGAL_MONITOR_STATE = IllegalMonitorStateException.class;
067
068    /**
069     * Pre-defined exception arrays according to chapters 5.1-5.4 of the Java Virtual Machine Specification
070     *
071     * @deprecated Do not use these arrays, use the static methods in the ExceptionConst implementation class instead
072     */
073    @Deprecated
074    Class<?>[] EXCS_CLASS_AND_INTERFACE_RESOLUTION = {NO_CLASS_DEF_FOUND_ERROR, CLASS_FORMAT_ERROR, VERIFY_ERROR, ABSTRACT_METHOD_ERROR,
075        EXCEPTION_IN_INITIALIZER_ERROR, ILLEGAL_ACCESS_ERROR}; // Chapter 5.1
076    @Deprecated
077    Class<?>[] EXCS_FIELD_AND_METHOD_RESOLUTION = {NO_SUCH_FIELD_ERROR, ILLEGAL_ACCESS_ERROR, NO_SUCH_METHOD_ERROR}; // Chapter 5.2
078
079    /**
080     * Empty array.
081     */
082    @Deprecated
083    Class<?>[] EXCS_INTERFACE_METHOD_RESOLUTION = new Class[0]; // Chapter 5.3 (as below)
084
085    /**
086     * Empty array.
087     */
088    @Deprecated
089    Class<?>[] EXCS_STRING_RESOLUTION = new Class[0];
090    // Chapter 5.4 (no errors but the ones that _always_ could happen! How stupid.)
091    @Deprecated
092    Class<?>[] EXCS_ARRAY_EXCEPTION = {NULL_POINTER_EXCEPTION, ARRAY_INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS_EXCEPTION};
093
094}
